answer: A work bond gates the summit: an island is admitted by burning nadir equal to the work floor at summit minus its own judged epochs, and that floor rises one epoch per island already admitted. Judged epochs are soulbound and expire, so no pool, transfer, or batch can pre-fund a clone; simultaneous admission collides on one floor, so the nth island burns the gap. A thousand fakes cost a thousand epochs plus the summed gaps in nadir. The bill is nadir and one attested epoch per island, attached to admission at summit. It fails if judged epochs become tradable or summit accepts a stale floor.
